title.zh: ZachXBT: AXIS Insiders Dump ~42M Tokens From Team Multisig, Triggering 40% Crash
title.en: ZachXBT: AXIS Insiders Dump ~42M Tokens From Team Multisig, Triggering 40% Crash

current_state.zh: ZachXBT alleges AXIS insiders received over 76M tokens (~$12M) from the team multisig and dumped roughly 42M (~$5.04M) via DEXs into Bitget, crashing the price 40% days after Binance, Coinbase and Upbit listings.
